contract.task_clause:
Which of the following are harmed by unexpectedly high rates of inflation?
Option A: Borrowers repaying a long-term loan at a fixed interest rate.
Option B: Savers who have put their money in long-term assets that pay a fixed interest rate.
Option C: Workers who have negotiated cost-of-living raises into their contracts.
Option D: Renters of apartments who have signed a lease that holds rent constant for two years.
